The '''Dihneral system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing]]|system=Dihneral [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dihneral [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
